Add money, bid, win and collect. Here’s how LotVanta works.

Bid. Win. Save.

Welcome to LotVanta

Hi {{name}},

New items go up for auction every day, often far below shop prices. Here’s how to get started:

1

Add money to your wallet

Top up by bank transfer to your own LotVanta account number, or by card. Your money stays in your wallet until you use it.

2

Bid on what you want

When you bid, we hold the full amount, fees included, in your wallet. You’re only charged if you win. If someone outbids you, the money goes straight back to your wallet.

3

Win and collect

When you win, payment comes from your wallet automatically. Collect your item from the pickup centre within 5 working days, using the QR pickup pass in your account.

Then do it again: new auctions start every day.

Browse today’s auctions

Add money to your wallet

We’ll never ask for your password or a sign-in code. If anyone does, it isn’t us. You received this email because you created a LotVanta account.
